name: TetraBOT
summary: TetraBOT is a Nanjing robotics company founded in 2011. It develops robots, sensing hardware, diagnostic algorithms and industrial software for equipment inspection and maintenance. Its systems serve energy, petrochemical, mining and public infrastructure environments. The company’s humanoid portfolio includes T12, a mobile dual-arm robot designed to combine inspection with physical operation, and the Tian Kui explosion-proof humanoid.
